name: Vacuum Einstein equations: R_kk = 0 outside the source, so the optical tidal matrix is traceless (pure Weyl)

source.located: Classic content: Sachs, Proc. R. Soc. A 264, 309 (1961) (null optical scalars; Ricci term = trace, Weyl term = trace-free part of the optical tidal matrix) and the vacuum Einstein equations R_ab = 0 -- no arXiv copy, NAMED-NOT-READ. Restatement used: Gao & Wald, gr-qc/0007021v2 (CQG 17, 4999, 2000), eq.(11) Jacobi-matrix equation d^2A/dlambda^2 = -R_{alpha beta sigma}^mu k^alpha k^sigma A^beta_nu with A|p = 0, dA/dlambda|p = delta; eq.(12) G = sqrt(det A); eq.(13) 'G''/G = -(1/2)[sigma_ab sigma^ab + R_ab k^a k^b] where sigma_ab denotes the shear of the congruence of null geodesics emanating from p' -- the paper the tree itself cites (composite.py:112-114).
source.via: Gao-Wald eqs.(11)-(13) READ this stage from the full text cached in the docket scratchpad (scratchpad/d67/src/casmag/all/gr-qc_0007021v2.txt, lines 470-535), which was fetched at source by the sibling audit audits/gr-qc_0007021.json (alphaXiv get_paper_content fullText=true, READ). published_statement: Gao & Wald 2000 eq.(13) (READ): G''/G = -(1/2)[sigma_ab sigma^ab + R_ab k^a k^b], G = sqrt(det A), A the Jacobi matrix of eq.(11). Standard content (Sachs 1961, NAMED-NOT-READ; proved here as V1): on a screen {e1,e2} orthonormal and orthogonal to null k (and an auxiliary null l, k.l = -1), the optical tidal matrix T_ij = R_{a m b n} e_i^a k^m e_j^b k^n satisfies tr T = R_ab k^a k^b and T = T_Weyl + (1/2) R_kk I with T_Weyl trace-free; the vacuum Einstein equations R_ab = 0 then give tr T = 0, so all focusing is by the Weyl (shear-sourcing) part.
published_hypotheses: 4D Lorentzian metric, Levi-Civita connection (the identity tr T = R_kk is pure algebra of the Riemann symmetries; V1)
k NULL (g(k,k) = 0) and the screen orthonormal and orthogonal to k (and to l); with non-null k the 2-D screen trace is not R_kk
vacuum Einstein equations R_ab = 0 (Lambda = 0), or Lambda-vacuum R_ab = Lambda g_ab, which still gives R_kk = Lambda g(k,k) = 0 (V1h)
an EXACT solution of those equations: the conclusion is tr T = 0 exactly, not to some order
Gao-Wald's own Lemma 1/Theorem 1 hypotheses (NEC, null generic condition, completeness) govern their theorems, not eq.(13) or this identity
hypothesis_drift: WEAKENED, NAMED: exact vacuum -> the linearised metric ds^2 = -(1+2Phi)dt^2 + (1-2Phi)dx^2, Phi = -M/r (composite.py:34-35, 131-136), which is Ricci-flat only at O(M): R_kk along a null ray at (x, y, 0) = 2 M^2 (5x^2 - 2y^2)/r^6 + O(M^3) (V3a-c). The tree names the linearisation (composite.py:102-104; 326-327 attributes its static residue to 'the metric's own O(Phi^2)'), so this is not a dropped hypothesis -- but its quantitative consequence is misstated, next items.

DROPPED at the static check: null k. composite.py:322-323 evaluates the tidal matrix with k = (1,1,0,0), which in the tree's metric has g(k,k) = -4 Phi = -2.667e-2 at (0, 0.3, 0), M = -2e-3 (V4d). The source's identity needs null k (V1). With an exactly null k and orthonormal screen, |tr|/|max| = 8.69e-3 ~ 4|M|/(3b) (V4f), not the 1.6e-4 'four digits' of composite.py:43-44, 324-325.

MISATTRIBUTED residue (discrepancy, composite.py:326-327): the tree says 1.6e-4 is 'h-independent ... over an order of magnitude in step size, so this residue is the metric's own O(Phi^2)'. Its own tidal() gives 1.710e-3, 4.721e-4, 1.623e-4, 8.48e-5, 6.55e-5, 6.00e-5, 5.92e-5 for h = 4e-3 ... 5e-5 (V4b): h-dependent by x29; the h -> 0 limit 5.90e-5 equals the exact-derivative value (V4c) and scales as M^2 (V4g), i.e. it is a cancellation between the O(M^2) Ricci and the non-null-k term, not 'the metric's own O(Phi^2)'.

MISATTRIBUTED leak (discrepancy, composite.py:328-333): the along-ray 'leak' 9.29e-3 is attributed to first-order Euler screen transport; it is step-independent (9.37e-3 / 9.29e-3 / 9.25e-3 at n = 450 / 900 / 1800) and linear in |M| (4.62e-3 / 9.29e-3 / 1.90e-2 at |M| = 1e-3 / 2e-3 / 4e-3), matching the null-screen O(M^2) Ricci ratio of V4f to 7% (V6b, V6c). The 'under 2 %' check therefore measures the linearised metric's non-vacuum part, and extrapolates to 4|M|/(3b) = 4.4 %, 8.9 %, 17.8 % at the window rows |M| = 1e-2, 2e-2, 4e-2 (composite.py:62-68) -- where 'pure Weyl' is correspondingly less pure. Inside the tree's named limitation 2 (composite.py:102-104, 'INDICATIVE').

ADDED claim resting on it (composite.py:90-92 'T_kk = 0 along the whole path -- so it does not violate ANEC anywhere'): true of any exact vacuum completion (Schwarzschild of either sign of M is exactly Ricci-flat for r > 0, V2a), but for the metric the tree actually integrates, G_kk = R_kk = O(M^2) != 0 and its ANEC-type integral along the straight ray is -pi M^2/(4 b^3) < 0 for either sign of M (V4h). Size relative to the Weyl focal power 4|M|/b^2: pi|M|/(32 b) = 6.5e-4 at |M| = 2e-3, 1.3e-2 at 4e-2. An artefact of linearisation, not physics, but the statement 'T_kk = 0' is not literally true of the pipeline's metric.

SIGN CONVENTION (discrepancy, composite.py:229-235 with 250-255): composite.tidal returns -R_{m a n b} k^m e^a k^n e^b = -(MTW optical tidal matrix) (V5a), and the evolution A'' = -T A therefore focuses the RADIAL screen direction for M > 0, whereas the tree's own geodesic integrator shows TANGENTIAL neighbours converging and radial ones diverging for M > 0 (V5b). Because T is traceless to O(M), T and -T give the same conjugate parameter: lambda = 55.17 (M = +2e-3) and 56.50 (M = -2e-3) under both signs, against geodesic-bundle truth 55.23 and 56.63 (V5c). The tree's table values and 'both signs seat' survive; only the unreported direction label is swapped. Tracelessness is exactly what makes this sign error invisible.

lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested: the result is an algebraic identity (tr of the screen-projected Riemann = R_kk, Weyl trace-free; V1, proved over a basis) plus the field equations; it uses NO measured datum. The one physical quantity that could have been 'lacking' in 1961 is the cosmological constant, measured since 1998 (Omega_Lambda = 0.6847 +- 0.0073, Planck 2018, READ from cache): it does NOT change the conclusion, because R_ab = Lambda g_ab gives R_kk = Lambda g(k,k) = 0 for null k (V1h, symbolic). Nor does the sign of M: exact Schwarzschild is Ricci-flat for either sign (V2a), so a negative-mass lens is exactly as vacuum as a positive one. Evidence either way, then: no later datum moves the result. What does move is not data but the tree's APPLICATION -- the linearised metric is non-vacuum at O(M^2), which the tree names but mis-sizes (four digits claimed vs ~0.9 % on a correct null screen; 'Euler leak' that is really the metric's Ricci).
grade_evidence: The external result STANDS: 'vacuum (R_ab = 0, or R_ab = Lambda g_ab) => R_kk = 0 => optical tidal matrix trace-free, pure Weyl' is PROVED here for every 4D curvature tensor and every null k / orthonormal screen (V1, exact rational arithmetic over a 20-element basis, vacuity guard passing; V1h Lambda), confirmed on exact Schwarzschild with symbolic M of either sign (V2: T = diag(+-3ML^2/r^5), trace identically 0), and consistent with Gao-Wald eq.(13) READ from cache. No datum enters (V1h shows Lambda's measured value cannot move it). Recorded tree-side DISCREPANCIES, none a refutation of the result and none quoted as an error of the source: (1) the linearised metric the tree applies it to is Ricci-flat only at O(M) -- named by the tree (composite.py:102-104, 326-327) -- and on a correct null screen its trace is 8.69e-3 of max at the static point, not 'four digits' (composite.py:43-44); (2) the quoted 1.6e-4 comes from a non-null k = (1,1,0,0) (g(k,k) = -4 Phi) plus finite-difference error, and is h-dependent by x29, contradicting 'h-independent' (composite.py:326); (3) the along-ray 'Euler leak' (composite.py:328-333) is step-independent and linear in |M|: it is the O(M^2) Ricci, reaching ~4.4-17.8 % at the window's upper rows |M| = 1e-2..4e-2; (4) 'T_kk = 0 along the whole path' (composite.py:90-92) is true of the exact vacuum completion but not of the integrated metric, whose O(M^2) R_kk has ANEC-type integral -pi M^2/(4b^3) < 0 (small: 6.5e-4 of the Weyl power at |M| = 2e-3); (5) composite.tidal carries the opposite sign to the MTW tidal matrix, swapping which screen direction focuses, yet leaves every conjugate parameter unchanged (55.17 / 56.50 under both signs vs bundle truth 55.23 / 56.63) precisely because T is traceless. rests_on_it: 'Ricci focusing is OFF here' (composite.py:334) holds at O(M) and to 6.5e-4 in integrated effect at |M| = 2e-3; 'Weyl focusing is sign-blind' (specthm.py:1326) holds for conjugate-point existence and location (V5c). what_would_change_the_grade: Nothing about the identity itself: it is proved (V1) for all 4D curvature tensors. The grade would drop to NARROWED only if the tree were read as asserting tracelessness of its linearised metric beyond O(M) as a consequence of the theorem (the O(M^2) Ricci is 4|M|/(3b) of the Weyl part on a null screen), which it explicitly does not (composite.py:102-104, 326-327). It would move to OPEN if V1 failed to run and only the unread Sachs text remained. A modified-gravity or higher-dimensional reading (extra Ricci-like terms, D != 4 Weyl decomposition coefficients) is outside the tree's use and was not checked.
